import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Get station types to identify roadside vs general stations
query = text("""
SELECT id, station_type, name_en
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE station_type IN ('ROADSIDE', 'GENERAL')
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Station types:")
print(stations)
print()

# Step 2: Compute average NO2 and PM2.5 for October 2025 by station type
query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.station_type,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND aqs.station_type IN ('ROADSIDE', 'GENERAL')
GROUP BY aqs.station_type
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Average concentrations by station type (October 2025):")
print(df)
print()

# Extract values
roadside = df[df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE']
general = df[df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL']

roadside_no2 = roadside['avg_no2'].values[0]
general_no2 = general['avg_no2'].values[0]
roadside_pm25 = roadside['avg_pm25'].values[0]
general_pm25 = general['avg_pm25'].values[0]

no2_roadside_general_ratio = round(roadside_no2 / general_no2, 2)
pm25_roadside_general_ratio = round(roadside_pm25 / general_pm25, 2)

print(f"NO2 roadside/general ratio: {no2_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"PM2.5 roadside/general ratio: {pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")

if no2_roadside_general_ratio > pm25_roadside_general_ratio:
    more_traffic_dominated = "NO2"
else:
    more_traffic_dominated = "PM2.5"
print(f"More traffic-dominated pollutant: {more_traffic_dominated}")

# Step 3: Now compute rush hour vs off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratios at roadside stations
# Rush hours: 08:00-09:59 and 17:00-18:59 (typical HK rush hours)
# Off-peak: 00:00-05:59 (early morning, lowest traffic)

query = text("""
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (8, 9, 17, 18) THEN 'rush'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'offpeak'
        ELSE 'other'
    END as period,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND aqs.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
  AND (
      EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (8, 9, 17, 18)
      OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 5
  )
GROUP BY period
""")
df_period = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Roadside NO2 and PM2.5 by period:")
print(df_period)
print()

rush = df_period[df_period['period'] == 'rush']
offpeak = df_period[df_period['period'] == 'offpeak']

rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(rush['avg_no2'].values[0] / rush['avg_pm25'].values[0], 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(offpeak['avg_no2'].values[0] / offpeak['avg_pm25'].values[0], 2)

print(f"Rush hour NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"Off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")
